title: The full Gaia colour-magnitude diagram with white dwarfs reveals a declining Milky Way star formation history
title_zh: 含白矮星的完整Gaia色星等图揭示银河系恒星形成史衰减
abstract: White dwarfs (WDs) provide a fossil record of the Milky Way star formation history (SFH) through the combined effects of stellar evolution and cooling. They have, however, generally been modelled in isolation from the non-degenerate population, so that no single self-consistent set of Galactic assumptions has been required to reproduce both. We present CALOMERA, a semi-analytic chemo-dynamical population synthesis framework in which the vertical density profiles of mono-age subpopulations are computed self-consistently with the Galactic potential and coupled to modern WD cooling sequences, metallicity-dependent progenitor lifetimes and synthetic photometry. We calibrate 18 parameters describing the initial mass function, SFH, initial-final mass relation and WD population against a Gaia DR3 sample of $7.98\times10^{6}$ stars within 1 kpc, including $1.1\times10^{5}$ WDs. The calibrated model reproduces the star counts in each colour-magnitude diagram region to within 3% and the total number count to within 0.5%, compared with the 81% excess in the predicted WD count obtained with the previous main-sequence-only calibration. The recovered SFH peaks early, declines exponentially thereafter, and includes two recent bursts, located at $τ\approx2.4$ and $0.5$ Gyr. Three cooling libraries (Montréal, BaSTI and LPCODE) yield comparably good fits, with differences confined to ${\rm M_G}\gtrsim15$ mag. The predicted luminosity function is in reasonable agreement with the 100 pc Gaia WD sample. We further predict the Galactic WD distribution and differential number counts for surveys of varying depth. Extending the framework to the substellar regime using ATMO models, we predict the Galactic L, T, and Y dwarf populations and their contribution to the deep JWST fields.
summary_zh: 以往白矮星与非简并星群模型相互孤立，缺乏自洽的银河系假设来同时重现两者。
提出CALOMERA半解析化学动力学框架，自洽计算子群垂直密度与星系势，耦合白矮星冷却序列与合成测光，并基于Gaia DR3数据校准18个参数。
校准模型将色星等图各区恒星数误差降至3%内；恢复的恒星形成史呈早期达峰后指数衰减，并含两次近期爆发。
comment: Submitted to MNRAS, 20 pages main text + 4 pages appendix, 13 figures

title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
title_zh: ArchSpace：记录、审查与引用LLM架构研究的平台
abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
summary_zh: 工业界与学术界在LLM架构创新评估上存在记录缺失与算力受限问题，难以验证大规模效果。
提出ArchSpace平台，通过记录实验与推理、社区审查及后续引用，系统化评估架构研究。
利用scaling laws从小实验预测大尺度模型loss，并提供基线与训练配方，经审查的想法可成为新基线。

title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
title_zh: K2V：面向物理合理视频生成的生成式关键帧方法
abstract: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.
summary_zh: 现有视频扩散模型生成的视频常存在显著物理错误，因其物理推理全在扩散过程中隐式完成。
提出K2V方法，将物理推理交由LLM关键帧生成模块，以语言显式推理并精细控制关键帧外观。
用关键帧约束视频生成模型，将扩散模型简化为物理正确状态间的插值，在物理基准上达到SOTA。

title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
title_zh: 扩散语言模型的重生成时机学习
abstract: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
summary_zh: 扩散模型重生成需知何时及改何物，诊断发现置信度无法暴露隐藏状态中的错误，且孤立重掩码易复现原错。
提出验证器DiVR，基于模型自身轨迹的最终正确性训练，预测部分序列能否达正确结果，决定何时重生成及保留哪个替代。
在五个推理基准上，DiVR将生成器平均准确率从35.3%提至43.4%，计算成本低于搜索基线，且能补充SFT和RL等后训练。

title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
title_zh: 面向连续编码任务的内化成本记忆框架CoReMem
abstract: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
summary_zh: 连续编码任务需为未知下一任务选记忆，需权衡记忆未来效用与读写成本及使用时机。
提出CoReMem框架，通过前瞻片段评估引导构建基于锚点的紧凑记忆，并适配Actor。
在ChainSWE上，CoReMem将27B模型解决率提升至25.7%，且成功运行步数与总token数更少。

title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
title_zh: 经典能量模型推理速度较循环模型快千倍
abstract: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.
summary_zh: 循环推理模型存在不稳定、训练慢且计算开销大的问题，难以高效求解简单谜题。
提出基于能量下降的CRAM模型，具备内置早停、计算量自适应及无需求解器微分等优势。
CRAM在数独和迷宫任务上训练与推理极快，准确率持平或更高，推理FLOPs至少降低282倍。

title: Where LLM Agents Get Stuck Debugging Databases: Access More Than Reasoning
title_zh: LLM代理调试数据库的瓶颈：访问权限甚于推理
abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly asked not only to write code but to debug running systems from live runtime data. We report a field observation of one such agent (Claude Code) as it diagnosed eight database incidents in a production message-dispatch engine. In every incident whose root cause depended on runtime concurrency, the agent announced a cause, shipped a fix, and later walked it back, and each wrong guess cost a deploy-and-observe cycle. Mapping each incident to what the agent lacked, we find that access to production state was the most pervasive bottleneck. The missing access included live lock views, untruncated deadlock reports, read-only execution, and an explicit environment context. An access gap was present in all five concurrency-dependent incidents: alone in one, and in four combined with a reasoning error such as anchoring on an early cause, incomplete exploration of the configuration, or a misreading of the code's transaction semantics. The three incidents that did not depend on concurrency needed nothing beyond what the agent already had. Within the incidents, the agent's wrong hypotheses were consistent with the evidence it could see; they were not fabrications. We argue that the next step for production-debugging agents is a forensics layer that gives the agent the access it lacks inside existing security controls. Such a layer would combine a safe interrogation API, a lock-and-deadlock flight recorder, and a production replay harness.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM代理在诊断依赖并发运行时的数据库故障时，常因缺乏生产状态访问权限而错误猜测根因。
方法：观察Claude Code代理诊断8起生产环境数据库事故，分析其失败原因与缺失能力。
结论：访问权限缺失是核心瓶颈，需构建含安全查询API与重放工具的法医层以弥补该缺陷。
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Systems and Software

title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
title_zh: Metal Sandbox：Apple Silicon上GPU编码代理的隔离执行与命令调度
abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
summary_zh: GPU编码代理交替执行各类命令导致GPU闲置，需提升并发执行效率与资源利用率。
提出Metal Sandbox，结合受限文件访问、原生命令执行与跨机命令级调度，支持串行命令共享执行槽及并行命令跨机迁移。
实验表明，在4节点下命令吞吐量提升1.68-2.05倍，动态调度使工具等待减少18.8%、批处理耗时降低22.3%。
系统已开源。
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code available at https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/metal-sandbox and https://github.com/WangHaoZhe/harbor

title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
title_zh: LiveGeo：持续演化世界中的地理智能体基准测试
abstract: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.
summary_zh: 现有评估多基于固定地理状态，无法测试动态环境下的决策。本文提出GeoWorld平台与LiveGeo基准，支持环境随时间演化并保留可验证状态历史。
LiveGeo要求智能体在演化环境中主动获取信息，验证先前决策证据的有效性，并在必要时修正计划，以评估其动态可靠性。
实验表明前沿LLM在静态任务上也表现挣扎，静态性能无法保证动态可靠性；核心瓶颈在于智能体难以获取转化证据并在演化中维持决策正确性。

title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
title_zh: 基于双智能体LLM管道的可扩展对话式评估系统
abstract: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly. In this paper, we present scalable conversational assessment, an LLM-based system that conducts interactive text-based conversations with students to assess their ability to make and support an argument. We use a two-agent architecture to separate concerns and reduce the likelihood that answers are leaked to the student: the interviewer interacts directly with the student, but only receives guidance about the next question to ask the student; the hidden evaluator knows the goals of the whole activity, tracks the student's progress using a rubric, and guides the interviewer on when to follow-up on the current question or proceed to the next question. The system was first tested using a collection of simulated students with LLM personas of a particular ability level or adversarial tactic (e.g., answer-extractors, prompt-injectors, confident fabricators). A novel element of this evaluation was that it required the use of a fictional assessment topic to prevent personas that shouldn't have information from using knowledge present in the LLM's pre-training. The system was also deployed in a small, elective AI literacy course in both formative and summative contexts. Through manual and post-facto AI review of the transcripts we identified opportunities to improve the follow-up question generation and ensure that grading only credited ideas that the student (and not the interviewer) contributed.
summary_zh: 口语考试可追问推理但难以规模化，本文提出基于LLM的对话式评估系统以实现可扩展的交互式考核。
采用双智能体架构分离职责：隐藏的评估者追踪进度并指导，面试官仅与学生交互，防止答案泄露。
经模拟学生测试与真实课程部署，发现需改进追问生成，并确保评分仅计入学生而非面试官贡献的观点。
comment: Version submitted to SIGCSE TS 2027 (not accepted). A revised version is in preparation

title: Cited but Unused: Parametric Provenance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: RAG中引用但未使用：参数化来源问题
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to attribute claims to their sources. These citations frequently misstate provenance, and standard verification cannot detect this. We measure provenance by counterfactual value substitution: a fact in the retrieved passages is replaced with a false variant and the model re-queried. We find that across five sizes of one model family and a second comparator family, 1.2% to 15.7% of citable claims derive from parametric memory rather than the retrieved context. At the most conservative substitution distance these figures are 4.6% and 8.5% on the two models we tested at it, with the rate rising with model size within a family. We further find that natural language inference verification, the standard approach, gives results indistinguishable from chance across models, even when restricted to the cited passage. We determine that the cause is structural: a model answering from memory selects a citation that agrees with its output. Comparing ten attribution methods on identical claims, the contrast between the model's distribution with and without context best separates provenance. Acting on that signal does not improve provenance honesty at these base rates. The resulting detector is hence still not accurate enough to act on: it measures what the model knew rather than what it used, and separating those remains the open problem.
summary_zh: RAG系统常错误归属引用来源，标准验证无法检测模型是否真正使用检索上下文生成声明。
通过反事实值替换测量发现，1.2%至15.7%的声明源于模型参数记忆而非检索上下文，且随模型增大而上升。
标准NLI验证效果无异于随机；对比有无上下文的输出分布能区分来源，但据此行动无法提升诚实度，分离记忆与使用仍是开放问题。

title: Learning Dynamics of the Influencer's Game in Resource Landscapes
title_zh: 资源景观中影响者博弈的学习动力学
abstract: Across domains as varied as ecology, economics, and online platforms, individuals are incentivized to position themselves within resource-rich strategy spaces. In this work we introduce a new spatial game framework called the influencer's game. Within this new framework players' strategies are represented as positions within a trait space. Players then receive a share of a portion of a resource based on their relative influence at that resource's points traits. For the influencer's game, we show that there is a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium that exists under strict log-concavity of the influence kernel. Using the unique equilibrium we show that the stability of the system depends on the influence kernel's parameters, number of players, and the resource distribution shape. For any dimension we demonstrate a stability threshold that depends on both the scatter and curvature of the players. When this threshold is crossed, the symmetric equilibrium destabilizes and gives way to a variety of bifurcation types; including, specialist clusters, limit cycles, and sub-games that reproduce the larger game's structure. We ground these results using real-world data for resources as a demonstration of the game's application. Finally we extend the game dynamics to use multi-agent reinforcement learning and further show that the predicted bifurcation structure persists under partial observability and discretized strategy spaces. In all, the influencer's game provides a novel framework for predicting when competitive pressure drives convergence versus fragmentation with possible applications across domains.
summary_zh: 针对个体在资源丰富策略空间中定位的竞争问题，提出影响者博弈框架，证明在严格对数凹性下存在唯一对称纳什均衡。
为分析系统稳定性，推导出依赖个体分散度与曲率的稳定性阈值，跨越该阈值会导致对称均衡失稳并引发分岔。
为验证分岔结构的鲁棒性，将动力学扩展至多智能体强化学习，证明其在部分可观测与离散策略空间下依然成立。

title: Three-body dynamics of the Roper resonance
title_zh: Roper共振的三体动力学研究
abstract: The enigmatic Roper resonance is notoriously difficult to determine in lattice QCD. Its quantum numbers, $J^P=1/2^+$, allow for two pions and a nucleon in relative $S$-waves. This absence of a centrifugal barrier leads to strong three-body $ππN$ effects on top of the two-body $πN$ channel -maybe the reason why the Roper is obscured in lattice QCD close to physical masses. Guided by unitarity, an amplitude is constructed in which three-body states are populated through channels in $f_0(500)N(939)1/2^+$, $πΔ(1232)3/2^+$, and $πN(1440)1/2^+$ configurations. The latter channel is required by unitarity in the presence of nucleon exchange, and it contains the nucleon as a bound state, generating the $πN$ channel automatically. With the sub-channels matching the corresponding two-body amplitudes from experiment and nucleon properties, the $P_{11}$ amplitude from SAID is fitted, allowing for an accurate determination of the Roper poles close to the complex $πΔ$ threshold. The Roper poles and residues are, for the first time, determined by explicitly including this and other non-analyticities in combination with strict two- and three-body unitarity. Contour deformation allows for a direct pole search. Systematic uncertainties from the parametrization dependence are quantified. The result for the Roper $S$-matrix pole is $\sqrt{s_R}/{\rm MeV} =1346\pm 2^{+6}_{-3} - i(81\pm 2^{+7}_{-8})$. The amplitude developed here will serve as the central input for a quantization condition that allows for future determinations of the Roper resonance from lattice QCD.
summary_zh: Roper共振在格点QCD中难以确定，可能源于其无离心势垒导致的三体ππN强效应。
基于幺正性构建含三体态的振幅，拟合实验与SAID的P11振幅，准确确定Roper极点。
首次显式包含非解析性与严格二、三体幺正性确定Roper极点与留数，为格点QCD提供关键输入。

title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
title_zh: 忠实于论文的联邦学习：面向从业者与智能体的科学检查
abstract: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol. Small errors in configuration, data partitioning, aggregation, randomness, evaluation, or checkpoint recovery may therefore affect a comparison without causing the program to fail. We present FedBrew, a research codebase for controlled and reproducible federated learning experiments. Its focus is controlled simulation with checks of specified conditions of the intended experimental protocol. FedBrew uses configuration checks, identifiable client data partitions, checkpoint recovery checks, self-describing run records, and development-time checks of scientific conditions. These checks assess, for example, whether client partitions are disjoint and exhaustive and aggregation weights match the prescribed rule; numerical and recovery checks examine non-finite client model states and interrupted runs. The same structure also provides clear extension points and automated checks for new algorithms, datasets, models, and tasks, whether they are added by researchers or AI coding agents. FedBrew therefore supports reproducible and inspectable FL experiments through checks of specified software and scientific conditions and the run records associated with reported results.
summary_zh: 联邦学习实验易因配置或聚合等微小实现偏差产生看似合理的结果，且程序不报错，影响对比公平性。
提出 FedBrew 代码库，通过配置、数据划分、检查点恢复及科学条件等检查，严格控制并复现 FL 实验。
该框架支持人工或 AI agent 扩展新算法时的自动检查，通过验证软件与科学条件及运行记录，保障实验可复现与可审查。

title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
title_zh: 参数高效简洁适应：小模型可微长度控制实现临床简明推理
abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
summary_zh: 小语言模型在医疗任务中回复过长，现有长度控制方法依赖偏好优化或辅助模型，削弱了其易用性。
提出PECA方法，在QLoRA微调目标中加入可微简洁项，超预算时提升序列结束概率以实现平滑优化。
无需偏好数据与辅助模型，PECA将平均回复长度降低72.8%，且诊断准确率从40.8%提升至44.0%。

title: Equidistribution of curves in hypersurfaces of low degree
title_zh: 低度超曲面中曲线的等分布
abstract: We prove that over $\mathbb{C}$, for any smooth projective curve $\mathscr{C}$ and any smooth hypersurface $V \subset \mathbb{P}^n$ of degree $d$ such that $n \geq 2^d(d-1)$, Faisant's equidistribution principle holds for $(\mathscr{C},V)$. In other words, for any reasonable set of jet conditions $W$, the moduli space $\mathrm{Hom}^e(\mathscr{C},V|W)$ of degree $e$ maps $\mathscr{C} \to V$ satisfying conditions $W$ converges in the Grothendieck ring of complex varieties, after renormalisation, as $e \to \infty$. This provides the dimension and decomposition into irreducible components of $\mathrm{Hom}^e(\mathscr{C},V|W)$ for $e$ large enough. The strategy follows Bilu and Browning's motivic version of the circle method, and Hase-Liu's framework for genus $\geq 1$.
summary_zh: 问题：研究复数域上光滑射影曲线到低度光滑超曲面的映射模空间的渐近行为，方法：引入合理的喷射条件并考虑度数趋于无穷的极限，结论：证明了Faisant等分布原理在此情形下成立。
问题：需确定满足喷射条件的度数映射模空间的维数与不可约分解，方法：利用等分布原理在复簇Grothendieck环中的收敛性，结论：给出了度数充分大时该模空间的维数及不可约分支分解。
问题：如何证明上述等分布与模空间分解结果，方法：采用Bilu与Browning的圆法动机版本及Hase-Liu的亏格大于等于1框架，结论：成功将策略推广至低度超曲面情形并完成证明。

title: Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
title_zh: 自主AI的制度设计
abstract: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual agents. In this Perspective, we argue that institutional design must become a distinct focus of AI research. Drawing on institutional political economy, social epistemology and organizational theory, we develop seven principles for designing AI institutions that sustain cooperation, enable reliable collective judgments and remain accountable to legitimate human purposes. These address reciprocal contributions, accountable authority, functional differentiation, epistemic pluralism, criticism and correction, human direction, and institutional adaptation. We illustrate their application through machine science, where autonomous research challenges institutions developed around human capabilities and constraints. We then propose an experimental research programme in which matched populations of AI agents operate under alternative institutional arrangements, and describe MoltJournal, an API-first journal for autonomous research agents, as an illustration of how such institutions can be made programmable and observable. Together, these contributions establish institutional design as a research agenda concerned not only with aligning autonomous agents, but with understanding how institutions can transform them into capable, reliable and accountable collectives.
summary_zh: 当前AI研究偏重个体，但自主AI群体的对齐与能力高度依赖其交互制度，需将制度设计作为独立研究方向。
借鉴政治经济学等理论，提出七项AI制度设计原则，以维持合作、保障集体判断可靠性并确保对人类负责。
提出AI群体制度实验研究计划，并以MoltJournal为例，说明如何构建可编程、可观测的AI制度。

title: Mathematical foundations for symmetric programming and reasoning
title_zh: 对称编程与推理的数学基础
abstract: We develop a mathematical abstraction for uniformly exploiting symmetries in programming and reasoning based on the mathematical proof principle `without-loss-of-generality' (w.l.o.g.). Given: group actions that describe symmetries of the input and the output; and a canoniser, which captures how arbitrary inputs get sent to canonical ones, our construction extends any function from the canonical inputs to the whole domain. We characterise the conditions on the canonisers which guarantee that the construction gives the unique equivariant (i.e. symmetry-preserving) extension. Furthermore, we adapt the construction to a dependently-typed setting, where it captures traditional symmetric w.l.o.g. arguments via the Curry-Howard correspondence. Finally, we extend the construction to algebraic data types, where the symmetries of the constructors both uniquely determine the symmetries of the data type and pave the way for efficient execution.
summary_zh: 问题：编程与推理中缺乏统一利用对称性的数学抽象。方法：基于“不失一般性”原则、群作用与规范化器。结论：构建了从规范输入到全域的函数扩展。
问题：需确定该扩展的对称性保持性质。方法：刻画规范化器的条件。结论：证明满足条件时，该构造给出唯一的等变（即保对称性）扩展。
问题：需将构造应用于类型系统与数据结构。方法：适配依值类型以对应 Curry-Howard，并扩展至代数数据类型。结论：捕获传统对称论证，且构造子的对称性唯一确定数据类型的对称性。

title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
title_zh: LoRA领域适配中的推理监督与能力保留
abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.
summary_zh: 金融微调易损害泛化能力，需在提升任务性能与保留通用能力间权衡。
对比Qwen3-8B的三种LoRA训练：仅响应、单适配器推理和双适配器复合训练。
仅响应LoRA域内提升最大且保留泛化；引入推理监督未带来额外收益，压缩推理摘要可向仅响应效果靠拢。

title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
title_zh: 通过程序演化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
summary_zh: 【问题】智能体记忆设计依赖人工且成本高【方法】提出MAPE框架，通过标准化生命周期与诊断-提议循环演化记忆程序【结论】准确率较人工基线最高提升12%，服务成本降至35%
【问题】缺乏对有效记忆设计模式的认知【方法】通过实证分析与消融实验挖掘设计规律【结论】保留原始对话作可检索证据并按查询意图组合，能提升模型使用效率，移植该组合模块至5个系统均提升准确率
【问题】优化目标如何影响计算资源分配【方法】分析同时优化准确率与服务成本的搜索目标【结论】计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转移到查询时的选择性处理，在保持准确率的同时降低成本

title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
title_zh: 审计AI同行评审员：基于真实论文的基准测试
abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
summary_zh: 现有LLM同行评审缺乏有效评估，故构建基准，向真实论文注入四类三级客观错误，以检测率和误报率衡量评审员性能。
提出多智能体评审系统Skepthical，通过检索引用文献、计算机代数验证数学及执行代码验证数值，核实论文声明。
实验表明模型选择对检测率影响最大；工具辅助在模型自身不足时有效，如Skepthical在天体物理引用错误检测上大幅领先，但在ML中无显著优势。

title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
title_zh: AURA 2.0：从用户驱动到模型主动发起对话的流视频LLM
abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.
summary_zh: 现有AI助手仅被动响应，无法在视频流出现有价值事件时主动交互，为此提出AURA 2.0。
引入模型主动发起对话(MIC)、流感知工具调用(SATC)与交互式视觉定位(IVG)，并构建专属数据集与三阶段训练方案。
结合长视野交互记忆(LHIM)保持上下文连续性，模型在公开基准测试中达开源最优，已开源权重与代码。

title: Pseudovortex-assisted generation of first-order vector modes
title_zh: 借助伪涡旋生成一阶矢量模式
abstract: A practical method of generating first-order vector modes like radially and azimuthally polarized modes is using the so-called vortex waveplates. Shining these plates with Gaussian beams produces parasitic higher-order modes besides the target vector beam. The reason is that there is a mismatch between the incident Gaussian mode and the doughnut-shaped profile required for the vector beam. This imposes a limit on the fidelity of the generated mode with respect to the target vector beam. In this work we demonstrate theoretically and experimentally that this limit can be overcome if the input Gaussian beam is replaced with a pseudovortex beam, which is a doughnut-shaped mode without topological charge. We use a spatial light modulator to generate this input mode and a geometric-phase-compensated triangular cavity for mode analysis. We demonstrate vector mode fidelity as high as $0.921 \pm 0.013$, which is considerably better than $0.815 \pm 0.003$ obtained with Gaussian input. We also investigate the fidelity as a function of the input beam waist, leading to a theoretical upper bound for the fidelity of $8π/27 \approx 0.931$, in close agreement with the experimental results. This approach presents a reliable method of generating high-fidelity vector modes.
summary_zh: 用涡旋波片生成一阶矢量模式时，入射高斯光束与目标环形轮廓不匹配，会产生寄生高阶模式并限制保真度。
用无拓扑荷的伪涡旋光束替代高斯光束作为输入，结合空间光调制器和几何相位补偿三角腔进行实验验证。
该方法将矢量模式保真度从0.815提升至0.921，并推导出0.931的理论上限，实现了高保真矢量模式生成。

title: From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
title_zh: 从委派到协调：学习高效的多智能体深度研究
abstract: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context. Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence. Existing training either optimizes only the main agent or broadcasts the same team advantage to all agents, which can reward misleading subagent reports and penalize useful ones. We introduce LEAD-RL (Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning), a joint main-agent-subagent training framework with contribution-aware credit assignment. A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used. Across five benchmarks and two model families, LEAD-RL improves answer quality. On BrowseComp, it improves accuracy by 2.49 percentage points and reduces critical-path cost by 24.5% over joint training with shared team credit. During validation, accuracy increases by 6.78 points at approximately constant critical-path cost. These results show that contribution-aware credit assignment improves the quality-efficiency trade-off of multi-agent deep research.
summary_zh: 多智能体深度研究系统中，现有联合训练共享团队奖励，易奖励误导性子智能体报告而惩罚有用报告。
提出LEAD-RL框架，采用贡献感知的信用分配，通过评估子智能体报告的研究效用来调节其继承的团队优势。
实验表明，LEAD-RL提升了答案质量，在BrowseComp上准确率提升6.78点且关键路径成本恒定，改善了质量与效率的权衡。

title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
title_zh: Skill Adapter：通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users. In long-horizon tasks, subgoals, available inputs, and environmental states change as execution progresses. Agents must select currently applicable skills from an expanding skill pool and prepare candidates for subsequent steps. We propose Skill Adapter, which enables personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills. The system distills local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback and stores them as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills. The routing agent selects general-purpose skills and applicable Adapters based on the current subtask, execution progress, and environmental feedback, incrementally maintaining a task-level online skill library that the main LLM reads on demand. The system preloads candidates for subsequent nodes and rechecks their applicability once actual inputs are determined. Reinforcement learning optimizes the two types of decisions using modification gains and routing outcomes, respectively. We evaluate Skill Adapter on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench. Compared with SkillRL, it improves task success rates by an average of 11.43 percentage points and reduces mean execution time on all three benchmarks. Skill Adapter retains its performance advantage when the skill pool grows to 1,000 skills.
summary_zh: 通用技能难以满足用户个性化需求，且长序列任务中需动态选择技能。提出Skill Adapter，实现通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由。
系统从反馈中提取局部调整存为Adapter，路由Agent根据当前状态选择技能及Adapter，动态维护在线技能库。
采用强化学习优化修改与路由决策。在三个基准上较SkillRL平均提升11.43%成功率，且在千级技能池中保持性能优势。

title: AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
title_zh: AnalogLayoutWorld：面向智能体模拟电路布局设计的开放基准
abstract: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood. We study this question through analog circuit layout, which demands domain knowledge, geometric reasoning, and iterative interaction with design and verification tools. We introduce \textbf{AnalogLayoutWorld}, an open-source agent benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks for end-to-end layout generation from fixed transistor-level netlists. It combines an integrated design environment with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification, as well as objective layout quality metrics co-designed with analog layout experts. Across 13 model--harness configurations, 91.1\% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0\% satisfy the benchmark's acceptance criteria. We also evaluate Novara, an internally developed agent system, which achieves the highest reported aggregate score. Our analysis links performance differences to test-time scaling under fixed budgets, suggesting that reasoning efficiency and effective use of verification feedback help sustain design quality as task complexity grows.
summary_zh: 现有 Coding agent 处理受物理约束的长周期工程任务能力尚不明确，需通过模拟电路布局进行评估。
提出 AnalogLayoutWorld 基准，含 40 个专家审核任务及集成设计环境，支持独立验证与客观质量评估。
实验表明仅 23% 的布局满足验收标准；推理效率与有效利用验证反馈是维持设计质量的关键。

title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
title_zh: Primer：以教师为中心的教育模拟创建AI框架
abstract: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance. High-quality simulations, however, are difficult to build, requiring instructor input, scenario design, character development, scaffolding, technical implementation, and repeated revision. This paper presents Primer, an open-source, LLM-agnostic AI-supported system that helps educators create adaptive educational simulations. Educators contribute their knowledge of the subject, lesson, and students, while generative AI produces responsive variations of practice for students. Primer uses a multi-agent system centered around executing educator's instructional intent through the entire learning experience. We hope that by releasing Primer as an open-source system, including its prompts and GitHub repository, we provide a foundation for development and research on educator-in-the-loop AI authoring, multi-agent educational workflows, and simulation-based pedagogy. Further, by allowing the use of various AI models, including local and open source models, we provide the opportunity for implementation under varied governance regimes. Primer points toward a model of educational AI in which instructors can create locally grounded practice opportunities based on their own materials, goals, examples, and knowledge of students.
summary_zh: 高质量教育模拟构建困难，需大量设计与技术投入。提出Primer系统，利用生成式AI辅助创建自适应模拟。
教师提供学科与学生知识，生成式AI产出练习变体。Primer采用多agent系统，全程执行教师教学意图。
开源发布Primer及提示词，支持多种LLM与本地模型。为教师参与AI创作与多agent教学流程提供基础。

title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
title_zh: 思考的价值：混合决策模型中学习何时推理
abstract: Existing adaptive-reasoning methods shorten the explicit reasoning a model writes, or skip it by switching modes; either way the answer is still written out token by token. \emph{Rather than deciding how much to think}, we explore a different paradigm, \emph{zero-or-$T$ thinking}: a single model either answers from the implicit thinking inside one forward pass, generating no token, or performs full autoregressive reasoning at a cost of $T$ tokens when that is worth paying. We realise it in a \emph{hybrid decision model} (HDM), where one frozen backbone serves both modes and a lightweight \emph{self-routing block} chooses between them. The block estimates the \emph{value of thinking}, the utility the slow mode is expected to add over the fast one, from what that implicit thinking has already produced, and the slow mode runs only where that value exceeds a price $λ$ set per request. Where no per-decision label exists, as in episodic agentic tasks, we introduce \emph{Calibrated Decision Policy Optimisation} (CDPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that trains the block from episode-level returns. We evaluate HDM on MMLU-Pro, AGIEval, GPQA-Diamond, JevBench, BANKING77 and MiniWoB. Specifically, on JevBench HDM-4B scores $0.857$ against Jev's $0.851$ ($+0.7\%$) at a median $0.179$\,s against $0.652$ ($-72.5\%$). On the agentic venue MiniWoB HDM-27B cuts token cost by $80.1\%$.
summary_zh: 现有自适应推理仍需逐字输出，为解决此问题，提出零或T思考范式，模型仅在值得时进行完整自回归推理。
为实现该范式，提出混合决策模型HDM，由冻结主干与自路由块组成，通过估算思考价值决定是否启用慢速推理。
针对无逐决策标签的场景，提出CDPO强化学习算法训练路由块；实验表明HDM在保持精度的同时大幅降低推理耗时与token成本。

title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
title_zh: Lara Mini Base：将语言多样性视为资源而非权衡
abstract: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.
summary_zh: 通用模型英语数据占比过高，小模型中多语言竞争容量导致非英语性能下降。
提出Lara Mini base，基于6T词元从头训练，采用7.2B总参0.6B活跃参的MoE架构缓解容量竞争。
该模型在2B活跃参内取得最高平均分，多语言与数学优势显著，且单卡推理速度超同分模型1.8倍。

title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
title_zh: 面向类型化系统1决策模型的证据竞争攻击框架S1-Evo
abstract: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches. Unlike autoregressive System-2 (S2) models, S1 interfaces score dynamic rules and options without token-by-token decoding, mismatching attacks targeting text continuation or explicit override commands. We propose S1-Evo, a self-evolving framework tailored to S1's contract-based option competition and margin feedback. S1-Evo perturbs untrusted fields via contract-aware evidence channels to induce \emph{evidence competition} with original task evidence while preserving fact invariance. Offline on seed tasks, it optimizes candidates via feedback search guided by directional margins and re-verification, distilling verified flips into experience cards. At test time, S1-Evo retrieves relevant cards to construct perturbations for unseen tasks. Across four benchmarks and three S1 models, S1-Evo reaches 71.99\% mean ASR and 57.47\% high-confidence ASR on \texttt{jev-1.14}, and causes up to 24.00\% E2E agent violations.
summary_zh: LLM agent中的类型化系统1（S1）决策模型易受不可信上下文操纵，且现有针对自回归S2模型的攻击对其无效。
提出S1-Evo框架，通过契约感知通道扰动引发证据竞争，利用方向性边际反馈优化并蒸馏出经验卡片。
测试时检索经验卡片构建扰动，在四个基准上平均ASR达71.99%，并导致最高24%的端到端agent违规。

title: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
title_zh: 非小细胞肺癌中基于不确定性引导分诊的PD-L1肿瘤比例评分自动化
abstract: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.
summary_zh: PD-L1 TPS评分在1%和50%临界值附近易出错，需人工复核，现有自动化方法缺乏不确定性评估机制。
提出三阶段框架：识别肿瘤区域并排除巨噬细胞，用双分支网络D2Count-Net计数并计算TPS，再用TPS-Guard评估不确定性。
模型误差与病理学家相当；不确定性评估与误差高度相关；转诊最不确定样本后双方误差均降低，且可提升50%临界值敏感度。
comment: 55 pages (29-page main text with 5 figures and 3 tables, followed by 26 pages of supplementary material)

title: Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN
title_zh: AI-RAN中基于上下文图的可解释多智能体决策链
abstract: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources. When an alert or degradation appears, operators currently lack a structured way to trace which decision caused it, what context triggered that decision, and how other agents interacted. Existing explainability tools focus on single-model feature attribution or linear event logging, neither of which captures cross-agent decision chains. We propose the Context Graph, a heterogeneous directed graph that organizes policies, measurements, decisions, and alerts into a queryable explanation layer. Its foundational primitive is the Decision-Event node acting as a causal junction, where incoming edges capture triggering context and outgoing edges track downstream consequences that are progressively upgraded through counterfactual verification. Instantiated over existing E2, A1, and O1 data flows, our proof-of-concept demonstrates that compliance and diagnosis queries are resolved at sub-millisecond latency over graphs of tens of thousands of nodes, while reliably distinguishing true causal impacts from spurious correlations.
summary_zh: AI-RAN多智能体共享资源引发告警时，现有可解释工具无法追踪跨智能体决策链。
提出上下文图，将策略、测量与告警等组织为可查询图，以决策事件节点为因果枢纽。
实验表明，在数万节点图上查询延迟低于1毫秒，且能可靠区分真实因果与伪相关。
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: ACE-CaP-0: Real-World Code-as-Policies in the Era of Experience
title_zh: ACE-CaP-0：经验时代的真实世界代码即策略
abstract: Recent advances in frontier models have pushed the boundaries of agentic robot control, enabling agents to perform complex robotic tasks through reasoning and interaction. However, repeated calls to these models during execution can substantially increase task completion time. Code as Policies (CaP) offers a route for coding agents to acquire physical skills through experience and retain them in executable programs, allowing the reasoning invested in development to be reused across runs. Developing reliable code policies while limiting the cost of physical experimentation remains a central challenge. We investigate human guidance as a source of priors for feasible actions and simulation as an auxiliary environment for exploring and testing candidate policies. Our findings favor robot demonstrations available on request and simulation used selectively during real-world policy refinement. These findings inform ACE-CaP-0, an agentic recipe that couples policy revision with experience acquisition through Demonstrations on Request and Simulation on Demand. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks spanning alignment, multi-object handling, and bimanual coordination, the resulting frozen programs achieve 92.1\% success (221/240 trials). Mean execution times across tasks range from 0.97 to 2.27 minutes. The programs execute with runtime perception and control, without a human or coding agent in the loop. These results highlight CaP's potential to turn experience into reliable, reusable physical skills.
summary_zh: 【问题】前沿模型驱动的机器人控制因推理调用频繁导致执行耗时增加，且开发可靠代码策略的物理试错成本高。
【方法】引入人类引导作为可行动作先验，结合按需演示与按需仿真，提出ACE-CaP-0智能体方案来修正策略并获取经验。
【结论】在8项真实操作任务中，生成的冻结程序以92.1%成功率完成任务，平均耗时0.97至2.27分钟，验证了CaP将经验转化为可复用技能的潜力。

title: ControlHarbor: A Benchmark for Control Design by Coding Agents
title_zh: ControlHarbor：面向编码Agent的控制设计基准
abstract: LLM agents, i.e., language models run by a harness, can now write, run and debug software autonomously. This raises the question of whether they can also carry out control system design. In this paper, we consider control system design as a task for LLM agents and grade the designed controller as control engineers do: the controller is given in a single Python file mapping measurements to actions, evaluated on held-out seeds against an ordered set of requirements, under specified physical perturbations and structural certificates, without using neural networks. We formulate the task as a chance-constrained feasibility problem and instantiate it in ControlHarbor, a benchmark of 44 tasks over 13 plants, which includes network consensus, vehicle platooning, the MuJoCo hopper, walker and humanoid. The tasks are packaged in the Harbor format, so that any agent harness can be run against them, and the same environments also serve learning algorithms other than LLMs, such as reinforcement learning (RL), under the same evaluation. With ControlHarbor, we observe that the controllers designed by three frontier coding agents, Claude Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5.5, reach the RL return on every parity task, but only in a minority of sessions. We also observe that the controllers certified for return alone usually fail under perturbations. When robustness is part of the specification, a structured design meets it at the RL return on the humanoid task, where domain-randomised RL does not; under large pushes, domain-randomised RL succeeds and no designed controller does. The benchmark, the controllers, and their grades are released.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM agent能否自主进行控制系统设计？方法：将其视为机会约束可行性问题，构建ControlHarbor基准。结论：为评估编码agent的控制设计能力提供了标准化测试平台。
方法：要求agent输出单文件Python控制器，在物理扰动与结构证书下评估是否满足需求。结论：基准含44个任务与13个被控对象，兼容各类agent与RL算法的统一评估。
方法：在ControlHarbor上测试前沿编码agent与RL。结论：agent仅少数情况达到RL回报；仅认证回报的控制器常因扰动失败；结构化设计可获鲁棒性，但大扰动下仍不及RL。

title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
title_zh: Visual Cipher Bench：评估 LLM Agent 长程视觉推理
abstract: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.
summary_zh: 现有 Agent 基准多依赖文本规范与试错反馈，缺乏对需反复观察图像与自主交叉验证的长程视觉推理能力的评估。
提出 Visual Cipher Bench，包含 40 个视觉谜题，仅提供黑白线条图，要求 Agent 自主从图像中发现解题机制。
前沿模型准确率极低，但给予机制提示后大幅提升，表明当前 Agent 瓶颈在于无法自主发现视觉规则而非执行多步计划。

title: The uniqueness of smooth stationary black holes
title_zh: 光滑稳态黑洞的唯一性
abstract: We show that the domain of outer communications of a smooth, asymptotically flat, stationary vacuum spacetime describing a single rotating non-degenerate black hole is isometric to the domain of outer communications of a subextremal Kerr solution under reasonable geometric and physical assumptions, without analyticity or any smallness assumptions. The method is to apply Harrison transform to construct a family of solutions of Einstein--Maxwell equations. Combining null area comparison with the area-charge inequality, we show that, in the limiting transformed geometry, the bifurcate sphere has area radius one and constant electric and magnetic flux densities, with the original ADM mass normalized to $M=1$. These identities imply the technical assumptions of Ionescu--Klainerman, yielding the identification with Kerr.
summary_zh: 【问题】单旋转非退化光滑稳态真空黑洞是否唯一？【方法】无需解析性或小量假设，【结论】证明其与次极值Kerr解等距。
【问题】如何构造新解以分析黑洞几何？【方法】应用Harrison变换构建Einstein-Maxwell方程解族，【结论】在极限变换几何中获知分叉球面积半径与电磁通量密度性质。
【问题】如何最终确认Kerr等距？【方法】结合零面积比较与面积-电荷不等式推导恒等式，【结论】满足Ionescu-Klainerman技术假设，完成Kerr辨识。

title: Shortcuts or Memorisation? Revisiting Data Corruption in Natural Language Understanding with Large Language Models
title_zh: 捷径还是记忆？重温大模型在自然语言理解中的数据损坏
abstract: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words. Does the same hold for large language models (LLMs), and if so, is it because they have seen the benchmarks during pre-training? In this paper we revisit these perturbation experiments with eight LLMs alongside fine-tuned encoders on GLUE and the three rounds of ANLI. Regardless of model size, every system that answers directly retains 36-72% of its above-chance performance without nouns on MNLI compared to only 14-29% on ANLI. Only a model that reasons before answering departs from this pattern. We also check contamination indicators (including exact $n$-gram counts in the public pre-training data of two of the models) and find no link between exposure and robustness. Our strongest evidence comes from 368 new, human-validated items that none of the models can have seen. All eight LLMs keep more of their performance without nouns on items written in MNLI's style than on items written without its cues. When the perturbation instead removes the function words carrying such cues, this advantage reverses. In light of these results, we argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than memorisation, and tells us more about the benchmark than about the model.
summary_zh: 探究LLMs在输入受严重扰动时仍保持高准确率的原因，区分是记忆基准测试还是利用捷径。
对8个LLM进行扰动实验并检查数据污染，发现模型鲁棒性与预训练数据暴露度无关。
基于全新测试项验证，证明扰动鲁棒性源于数据集捷径而非记忆，反映的是基准测试的缺陷。

title: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 多轮LLM智能体RL中的结果质量对齐方法
abstract: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.
summary_zh: 多轮LLM智能体强化学习中，轨迹展开会导致结果统计重复和目标质量分配不均。
提出OMA方法，包含结果对齐与质量对齐两组件，显式处理统计与质量分配问题。
在ALFWorld和WebShop-SOL上显著提升成功率，证明轨迹展开隐式定义了权重规则。

title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
title_zh: 基于三元组增量训练的通用驾驶视觉语言模型
abstract: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.
summary_zh: 通用VLM适配自动驾驶常需大量3D先验或侵入式架构修改，本文发现其主要缺失仅为精确度量深度。
提出三元组增量训练框架，通过主VLM流适配任务、辅助深度流注入3D几何感知、冻结双生VLM流防语义漂移。
该方法在多项基准上超越现有驾驶VLM，3D感知媲美专家模型，且推理零开销并保留通用推理能力。
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)

title: Forecasting Sales Delay through Time-aware Analysis of Sales Events in Textual Reports
title_zh: 基于文本报告的时序感知销售延期预测
abstract: Business-to-business (B2B) companies develop and deliver a one-of-a-kind product in response to a client's orders. To prepare resources for development beforehand, companies estimate dates when they will receive orders from clients in their sales process, called scheduled order dates. However, dates when the companies actually receive orders can differ from the scheduled order dates. This difference increases costs in the development. If the difference could be forecasted before receiving orders, companies could optimize their resource preparation. Towards reducing the costs, we introduce sales delay forecasting, a novel task of forecasting delay days from the scheduled order dates during sales process where sales representatives (sales reps) interact with the clients to receive orders. Sales delay forecasting is challenging because the sales process progress inherently involves uncertainty and depends on the client's willingness to order. To address this task, we propose confidence features which represent sales reps' confidence as a proxy measure of the client's willingness to order. To represent it, our method extracts dates of future sales events anticipated by sales reps from textual reports. To consider whether the confidence objectively looks reasonable, we also introduce status features which describe sales process status based on current date and past events. In experiments using real sales data, our method achieved a 16% lower mean absolute error compared with a feature-based baseline similar to a prior work. Moreover, our method outperformed non-feature-based baselines using large language models, indicating that it is crucial to explicitly create our features.
summary_zh: B2B企业实际与预期订单日期的差异增加开发成本，需预测该延期以优化资源准备。
提出销售延期预测任务，从文本报告提取未来事件构建置信特征，并引入状态特征刻画进程。
实验表明该方法平均绝对误差较基线降低16%，且优于LLM基线，验证了显式特征构建的必要性。

title: PIM: A Physical Intuition Model for Low-Latency Prediction of Object Interaction Outcomes
abstract: Predicting object interaction outcomes from initial conditions is a central problem in data-driven physical reasoning. Existing methods often use rigid-body-level states or predict the evolution through autoregressive rollouts. Coarse representations cannot represent local deformation, while rollout errors may compound over long prediction horizons. Instead, we introduce PIM, a Physical Intuition Model that directly predicts a physical system's equilibrium state from its initial mesh geometry, kinematics, and physical attributes. PIM combines local k-nearest-neighbor (KNN) attention to encode intra-object geometry, anchor-based cross-object attention to model interactions, and a dual-branch decoder that predicts object-level translations and per-vertex residual displacements. Across MuJoCo scenarios involving both rigid and deformable interactions, PIM achieves lower vertex and centroid errors than the evaluated baselines. By predicting complete equilibrium states in a single forward pass, PIM substantially reduces latency relative to autoregressive learned models and MuJoCo rollouts under the evaluated protocols, enabling low-latency inference when only the final outcome is required.

title: MuSeToM: Multi-Sensory Evaluation of Belief Revision with Textual Cues Across Six Senses
abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer mental states in others, is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in large language models (LLMs) mainly focus on static belief attribution and false-belief reasoning, leaving a critical aspect of social reasoning underexplored: can LLMs decide whether perceptual evidence is sufficient to justify another person's belief revision? To address this gap, we present MuSeToM, a human-validated, text-based benchmark for evaluating epistemic belief revision in ToM reasoning. MuSeToM contains 2,415 instances adapted from BigToM and OpenToM, with textual cues spanning six sensory categories, and tests whether models can determine when a protagonist should revise a belief and infer the resulting updated belief state. Using MuSeToM, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs under direct and chain-of-thought prompting, revealing a pronounced dissonance: while models often detect that a belief may change, they struggle to identify the updated belief and frequently over-update on perceptually salient but epistemically insufficient cues.

title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
abstract: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inference with recorded environment responses and durations for ablations of individual optimizations. Live evaluations with Ling-3.0-Flash and Ling-3.1-Flash on the BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas benchmarks demonstrate makespan reductions of 10.4% to 65.0%, while evaluation scores remain aligned. Furthermore, these methods have been successfully applied to training and evaluation workflows for the Ling-3.x model series, accelerating the model-development cycle.

title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
abstract: Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$. We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.

title: Minimising Disquotational Truth
abstract: We present a new axiomatic theory of disquotational truth based on the theory of positive disquotation PUTB. Formulated in classical logic, PUTB restricts the T-schema to positive sentences and satisfies key epistemic desiderata (semantic conservativity and trustworthiness). However, it fares poorly in proof-theoretic strength compared to reflective truth frameworks. To address this, we propose a new theory of positive disquotation aimed at axiomatizing its least fixed-point model. Without requiring additional resources, we achieve this by incorporating ill-founded reasoning under suitable soundness restrictions, applying the tools of cyclic proof theory to axiomatic theories of truth. The resulting theory, CPUTB, is sound relative to the minimal fixed-point model and proves the same arithmetical theorems as the impredicative theory ID1.

title: Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?
abstract: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwater, an extension of Harbor that blocks all attacks tested in our study. Across 11 agents built from 7 frontier models and 2 harnesses, Opus 5.5 with Claude Code matches or outperforms the human baseline on all six tasks with a Singularity-Index of 1.25, suggesting it may have the skills needed to reach the singularity. The remaining agents average only 0.58. Our vision is for Singularity-Bench to track how much of AI development agents can already automate and when they may transition from assisting to taking end-to-end responsibility for building stronger successors.

title: AstroMemBench: A Benchmark for Memory Systems in Embodied Spacecraft Agents
abstract: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. Main experiments compare six configurations. Mem0, Chain-of-Memory, LightMem, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve same-session mean scores over native Pi Agent, with no clear advantage of the three memory systems over RAG. After a session restart, Mem0 outperforms RAG by 12.25 points. Benefits favor instruction retention and result reuse over ongoing state tracking and energy reservation. AstroMemBench supports the design, development, and selection of memory systems for embodied spacecraft agents.
